title: WIMSTA Formula Registry: body-composition and energy-expenditure equations with primary sources
description:
Open registry of 15 published equations for body composition and energy expenditure (categories: body-fat, body-fat-ranges, bmi, waist-to-height, max-heart-rate, bmr), each with its primary source, coefficients, input list, sex coding, units, reported error, sample and limitations. Every entry was checked against the primary publication; the verification status is recorded per entry.

Includes test vectors (145 input → output cases from the reference implementation, cross-checked against the live WIMSTA calculation API). Human-readable pages: https://wimsta.com/registry/.

Estimates for general information only; not medical advice.
